description: This file contains the implementation of the ProductService interface, providing various methods for managing products in an e-commerce platform. It includes functions for adding descriptions, retrieving products by different criteria, managing product creation, updates, deletions, and associated related entities like images, attributes, availabilities, and relationships. The class integrates with search indexing and database DAO layers.

classes.name: ProductServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the ProductService interface, handling product management logic including CRUD operations, searching, and indexing for products in an e-commerce application.

methods.name: addProductDescription
methods.description: Adds a new description to a product and updates the search index.

methods.name: getProducts
methods.description: Retrieves a list of products based on provided category IDs, with optional localization.

methods.name: getProductDescription
methods.description: Fetches the product description for a specific product in a specified language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on its search-engine friendly URL.

methods.name: getProductForLocale
methods.description: Fetches a product with locale-specific data, setting availability and language.

methods.name: getProductsForLocale
methods.description: Gets products within a category, filtered by locale, with availability filtering.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Lists products associated with a particular store, optionally respecting search criteria.

methods.name: listByTaxClass
methods.description: Lists products filtered by tax class.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a product based on a unique product code.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Removes a product, its images, relationships, and updates the search index.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new product and indexes it.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates product details, including related entities like availabilities, attributes, images, and relationships, and updates the search index.
